svg.title: Animated diagram: how a prompt moves through Prompt Forge
svg.text: How a prompt moves through Prompt Forge
Three prompts, three routes. The loop replays them in order.
skipped: short reply, /command, raw:, /forge off, or already specific → sent exactly as typed

g.text: What should the new name be?
A rough prompt is rewritten: goal first, your limits kept, a finish line added.
An unclear prompt is held. The forge asks, you answer, Claude continues with both.
Short replies, /commands and already-specific prompts skip the forge: no model call.
